name: parts_status
description: Report the connected distributors, each catalog's capabilities, and today's API quota. Call first in a part-selection task: it says whether category browsing (DigiKey) or keyword search only (Mouser) is available. With nothing connected, tell the user how to connect; do not invent parts.

name: app_scripting
description: Get the path and a snippet for this app's Python client, already on disk. Use for more than a handful of edits, computed geometry, or a generate-check-fix loop: a script is one turn. The app writes the client into its config directory to match this version; put the returned path on sys.path and import it, nothing to install. It is standard-library only: for numpy or other packages, run the script in your own venv. Every tool is a method with the same argument names; connect() finds the running app. Sheet helpers: gc.pin("U1.VDD") reads a pin's position and free side; gc.place_beside("Device:C", "U1.VDD", value="100nF") places a passive one grid step out on the pin and wires it. Board: gc.transaction(board=...) makes a batch one undo step, and refill=True pours zones once at the end. Read the worked example you need first.

name: project_context
description: Read the project's board-intent.md: purpose, assembly, quantity, sourcing, budget and conventions. Call before recommending parts and before the first design edit: assembly method and quantity decide packages and price breaks, and the conventions say how sheets are drawn and parts chosen. The content is returned verbatim. A missing file means the constraints are unwritten, not absent; say that anything you assume is a guess. missingSections lists the conventions headings the file lacks; agentsHasSection is whether AGENTS.md in the project root links board-intent.md.

name: project_create
description: Create a KiCad project in a folder: project file, root sheet and board, optionally with stackup and profile. A folder that already holds a project is refused with its name; one holding schematics needs adopt or blank: true. copperLayers and profile set the board's stackup, rules and Default class as Board Setup would; change them later with board_update_setup. Files are written to disk at once, with no undo. The project opens only in a window with no folder or this folder; otherwise the user opens it.

name.description: Project name: the file stem of its .kicad_pro, sheet and board.

folder.description: Absolute folder path. Default: the folder this window has open.

adopt.description: Schematic already in the folder to use as the root sheet.

blank.description: Create a new root sheet although the folder holds other schematics.

copperLayers.description: Copper layer count for the new board: 2, 4, …

profile.description: Manufacturing profile id, e.g. "jlcpcb-4l-1.6"; board_get_setup lists them.

name: project_create_file
description: Create a blank schematic sheet, board, symbol library or footprint library in the project. Written in the active project's folder at once, with no undo, and opened in a tab behind the active one (a footprint library is a folder, not a tab). A library is registered in the project's sym-lib-table or fp-lib-table under its name. A name already in the folder or the table is refused. For a child sheet, schematic_add_sheet makes the file and its sheet symbol together. A board starts with no outline: set its layers and rules with board_update_setup.

name.description: File stem, without extension (.kicad_sch, .kicad_pcb, .kicad_sym or .pretty is added); a library's nickname too.

name: project_save
description: Write open tabs with unsaved edits to disk: the named files, or every dirty one. Save only when the user asks or the next step needs the file on disk (kicad-cli, a script), and say which; unsaved edits stay undoable for the user. Any open document saves: schematic, board, library, text. The answer lists what was written and what is still unsaved; tell the user.

files.description: Open tabs to save, as absolute paths or bare file names. Default: every tab with unsaved edits.

name: project_open
description: Open a project file (schematic, board, library or text) as the active tab. Only files in the project tree open; a file name matching several files is refused with the candidates. The tab comes to the front; an open file is just activated. Nothing is edited.

file.description: Absolute path or bare file name, e.g. "phoneamenal.kicad_pcb".

name: project_close
description: Close an open tab. A tab with unsaved edits is refused: save it with project_save, or pass discard: true and tell the user the edits were dropped. Close and reopen a file to re-read it after something else changed it on disk.

file.description: Absolute path, or file name with its extension, of an open tab.

discard.description: Close even with unsaved edits, losing them. Default false.

name: parts_search
description: Search one distributor's catalog by keyword or manufacturer part number. Rows come in the distributor's order, each with every offer it lists (DigiKey: one per packaging), with minimum, stock and price breaks. Catalogs match names, not descriptions: a family ("SHT40") or kind plus value ("10k 0402") shows the variants; a sentence returns nothing. Distributor order codes match too; check the manufacturer. To check one MPN at every distributor use parts_compare_mpn; for a specification search, parts_search_category (DigiKey). Pass qty for the price at build quantity.

query.description: Family name, kind plus value, or MPN: "SHT40", "10k 0402", "STM32F405RGT6".

inStock.description: Only rows the distributor has in stock. Default false.

qty.description: Build quantity, selecting each offer's priceAtQty. Default 1.

limit.description: Rows to return from this distributor. Default 20.

offset.description: Rows to skip, to page. Default 0.

columns.description: Keys each row answers; default all. mpn is always kept. "offers" keeps whole offers, "offers.stock" one key of each.

name: parts_compare_mpn
description: Look up one exact manufacturer part number at every connected distributor. One entry per distributor: part is its row whose MPN matches whole, ignoring case, with every offer it lists. part is null when it lists none or several; manufacturers then names the makers it lists under that MPN, to pass as manufacturer. Find candidates with parts_search first.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number, matched whole, ignoring case.

manufacturer.description: Maker name as a distributor reports it, ignoring case.

qty.description: Build quantity, selecting each offer's priceAtQty. Default 1.

columns.description: Keys each row answers; default all. mpn is always kept. "offers" keeps whole offers, "offers.stock" one key of each.

name: parts_browse_categories
description: Walk DigiKey's own category tree, one level at a time. Call with no argument for the top level, then with parentId to descend. Use it when you know the kind of part but not a part number: filters exist only within a category. DigiKey only. The tree is fetched once per session; descending costs no quota.

parentId.description: Category id whose children to list; omit for the top level.

name: parts_list_filters
description: List a DigiKey category's filter parameters and values, each with its product count. Call before parts_search_category: it accepts only the ids returned here, and refuses any other. Product counts show which choice would narrow to nothing.

name: parts_search_category
description: Search one DigiKey category with parametric filters, to find a part by specification. Call parts_list_filters first: ids come from there, and one the category does not offer is refused at no quota cost. Filter by inStock and hasDatasheet routinely. has3dModel means only that the distributor lists a model; these tools cannot fetch it, so do not choose a part by it.

filters.description: Filters; parameters maps a parameterId to its valueIds, from parts_list_filters.

qty.description: Build quantity, selecting each offer's priceAtQty. Default 1.

columns.description: Keys each row answers; default all. mpn is always kept. "offers" keeps whole offers, "offers.stock" one key of each.

name: symbol_list_libraries
description: List every symbol library this project can see: standard, user-added and the project's own. The usual first call for a symbol: nicknames are a taxonomy (Regulator_Linear, MCU_ST_STM32L4). Browse one with symbol_list_library.

name: symbol_list_library
description: List the symbols in one library, each with its description and pin count. Prefer browsing to symbol_search: the description tells similar names apart (Device:R vs Device:R_Small). Check the pin count against the chosen part. Paged by offset and limit.

offset.description: Row to start at. Defaults to 0.

name: symbol_search
description: Find symbols by name, description or keyword across every library. For a known part number or family. An unranked substring match with no synonyms or spelling tolerance, so a vague query returns a long flat list; browse with symbol_list_library instead.

query.description: Terms that must all appear, e.g. "stm32f405" or "usb c".

power.description: true for power ports only (GND, +3V3), false to exclude them. Omit for both.

name: symbol_get
description: Read one symbol definition's pins, body box, fields and footprint filters, before or after placing it. Pin offsets are millimeters in sheet space, y down, from the origin at angle 0; a placed pin is at origin + offset, turned by schematic_place_symbol's angle. Footprint filters are the intended packages; pass one to footprint_search. A placed reference reads the sheet's copy, which may differ from the library.

symbol.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

sheet.description: With a reference: the sheet the symbol is placed on. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

unit.description: Unit (gate) of a multi-unit symbol. Defaults to 1.

style.description: Body style, e.g. 2 for the De Morgan drawing. Defaults to 1.

columns.description: Keys to answer; default all. libId, tier and the placed reference are always kept.

name: symbol_check
description: Run KiCad's symbol checker over one symbol definition: pin numbers, grid, power pins, prefix, shapes. One row per rule with the pins it names (pin:<number>). A definition has no revision, so no since. A placed reference checks its sheet's copy. Electrical checks on a sheet are schematic_check.

symbol.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

sheet.description: With a reference: the sheet the symbol is placed on. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

codes.description: Only findings with these codes, e.g. ["unconnected-pin"]; each answers a row with every finding, uncapped, count 0 when clean. Unknown codes are refused.

name: symbol_undo
description: Undo the last steps on a symbol's undo list, as Edit ▸ Undo does. The list is the tab's: the user's steps and every write's, newest first, each route_finish arrival its own. All steps or none. undone names each step taken back, next what each list would take next; a redo puts them back. A library symbol's list is its library tab's, so a step may be on another symbol in the library. A placed reference with sheet steps that sheet's list.

symbol.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

sheet.description: With a reference: the sheet the symbol is placed on. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

steps.description: How many steps, newest first. Default 1.

name: symbol_redo
description: Redo the steps last undone on a symbol's undo list, as Edit ▸ Redo does. Re-applies what an undo took back, newest first; any new edit to the document clears the redo list. All steps or none. redone names each step, next what each list would take next. A library symbol's list is its library tab's, so a step may be on another symbol in the library. A placed reference with sheet steps that sheet's list.

symbol.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

sheet.description: With a reference: the sheet the symbol is placed on. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

steps.description: How many steps, newest first. Default 1.

name: footprint_list_libraries
description: List every footprint library this project can see, with its footprint count. The usual first call for a footprint: nicknames are a package taxonomy (Package_QFP, Resistor_SMD). Project libraries sort first. A Footprint field naming a footprint no library has is refused.

name: footprint_list_library
description: List the footprints in one library, each with its description and pad count. Names carry body size and pitch (QFP-64_10x10mm_P0.5mm); descriptions name variants (HandSolder, ThermalVias). Check the pad count against the part, then footprint_get. Paged by offset and limit.

offset.description: Row to start at. Defaults to 0.

name: footprint_search
description: Find footprints by name, description or tag across every footprint library. Search the package name and pitch ("QFN-20 0.5mm", "SOT-23-5", "0402"). An unranked substring match with no synonyms, so a vague query returns a long flat list; browse with footprint_list_library instead.

query.description: Terms that must all appear, e.g. "qfn-20 0.5mm" or "usb c".

name: footprint_get
description: Read one footprint's properties, pads, courtyard and fab boxes, and linked 3D models with their resolved files. Read it before writing a Footprint field: pad numbers must match the symbol's pin numbers. Millimeters in the footprint's own frame, y down, origin at its anchor; a board's copy is read in that frame too. Properties and pads are in the records items_get answers for "footprint" and each pad. A model with resolved null is linked but not installed. Pads past 200 are counted, not listed.

footprint.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

board.description: With a reference: the board it is placed on. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path.

detail.description: pads (default): pads, boxes and models. full adds every graphic, text and property as items_get records.

modelFit.description: Footprints: decode each linked 3D model and answer its bounds and fit. Slow; off by default.

name: footprint_check
description: Run KiCad's footprint checker over one footprint: silk, pads, layers, courtyard, text, pad numbers. One row per rule with the item ids it names (pad:<number> is a pad). A definition has no revision, so no since; a write with checks: true answers the delta. Rules between footprints on a board are board_check.

footprint.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

board.description: With a reference: the board it is placed on. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path.

codes.description: Only findings with these codes, e.g. ["unconnected-pin"]; each answers a row with every finding, uncapped, count 0 when clean. Unknown codes are refused.

name: footprint_undo
description: Undo the last steps on a footprint's undo list, as Edit ▸ Undo does. The list is the tab's: the user's steps and every write's, newest first, each route_finish arrival its own. All steps or none. undone names each step taken back, next what each list would take next; a redo puts them back. A library footprint's list is its file's tab. A placed reference with board steps that board's list.

footprint.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

board.description: With a reference: the board it is placed on. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path.

steps.description: How many steps, newest first. Default 1.

name: footprint_redo
description: Redo the steps last undone on a footprint's undo list, as Edit ▸ Redo does. Re-applies what an undo took back, newest first; any new edit to the document clears the redo list. All steps or none. redone names each step, next what each list would take next. A library footprint's list is its file's tab. A placed reference with board steps that board's list.

footprint.description: A library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

board.description: With a reference: the board it is placed on. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path.

steps.description: How many steps, newest first. Default 1.

name: schematic_describe
description: Read a schematic sheet: its symbols and part fields, nets, unconnected pins, and the design's sheets. Call before writing to a sheet: references, pin ids and net names come from here. The answer carries a revision; pass it as since later to get only what changed.

sheet.description: The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Default: the open sheet, else the root sheet.

since.description: Revision from an earlier answer; returns only changes and removed ids since. An expired revision returns the whole sheet and says so.

name: items_get
description: Read items in full by id on a sheet, a board, a footprint or a symbol. Records come back in the shape items_update takes. Sheet: a symbol lists its box, fields and every pin with position, free side, net and `attached` (the ids sitting on the pin). Ids are a reference ("U1"; one unit of a multi-unit part is "U5A", and "U5" reads every unit), a field ("U1#Value") or a uuid; a pin is not an item. Board: millimeters, y down; a footprint lists its pads ("U1.3") with nets; a field ("U1#Value") reads as the board shows it: at and angle on the board, layer the board's. Footprint: its own frame; pads are "pad:<number>", the 3D link "model", its own properties (attributes, overrides) "footprint". A placed footprint (reference with board) reads the board's copy in the library frame. Symbol: its own frame, y down; pins are "pin:<number>", graphics "<kind>:<unit>.<style>.<index>", fields "field:<Key>". A placed symbol (reference, with sheet, else the open or root sheet) reads its sheet's copy.

footprint.description: Act on this footprint: a library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

symbol.description: Act on this symbol definition: a library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

board.description: Act on this board. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path. With footprint, the board a placed footprint is on.

sheet.description: Act on this sheet. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit it — with neither board nor footprint — for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

ids.description: Item ids, e.g. ["U1", "R1#Value"] on a sheet, ["U1.3"] on a board, ["pad:1"] on a footprint.

modelFit.description: Footprints: decode each linked 3D model and answer its bounds and fit. Slow; off by default.

name: items_query
description: List items on a sheet, a board, a footprint or a symbol by kind, region, nearness or net. Rows carry id, position and box; a board's track, via, graphic and text rows carry their own points and sizes instead of a box. Filters combine. A capped answer says truncated and names the counts to narrow by; offset with the revision it answered reads the next page. Sheet: near takes a pin or point; net matches symbols by their pins. For what is on a pin, read the symbol's `attached` with items_get instead. Board: near takes a point or an item id ("U1.3"); zones whose fill predates an edit are marked stale; zones a footprint carries list its reference. Footprint: filter by kind, layer, pad number, box or point; its own properties are the "footprint" row. Symbol: filter by kind, unit (0 is common to all units), pin number, box or point.

footprint.description: Act on this footprint: a library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

symbol.description: Act on this symbol definition: a library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

board.description: Act on this board. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path. With footprint, the board a placed footprint is on.

sheet.description: Act on this sheet. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit it — with neither board nor footprint — for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

kind.description: Only items of this kind; the kinds differ by document.

layer.description: Footprints and boards: items on this layer, e.g. "F.SilkS"; a *.Cu pad is on every copper layer.

unit.description: Symbols: only items of this unit.

number.description: Footprints and symbols: the pads or pins with this number.

box.description: A rectangle in the document's millimeters; items whose box touches it.

pin.description: A pin id from schematic_describe, e.g. "U3.2".

id.description: Boards: around the center of this item's box, e.g. a pad "U1.3" or a footprint "C4".

near.description: Around a pin (a sheet), an item's center (a board), or a point in millimeters, within radius; a board item is near when its box is.

radius.description: Millimeters around near. Defaults to 5.08 on a sheet, two grid squares, and 1 on a board or a footprint.

net.description: Only items on this net; on a sheet, symbols match by their pins.

offset.description: Matches to skip: the next page starts at the rows already read. Defaults to 0.

revision.description: Sheets and boards: the revision the first page answered; refused once the document moved, so the pages join.

modelFit.description: Footprints: decode each linked 3D model and answer its bounds and fit. Slow; off by default.

name: items_update
description: Change one item by id on a sheet, a board, a footprint or a symbol. Send only what changes, in record; a key the item's kind lacks is refused. One undo step on the document's tab; on a sheet or board, a record that sets layout needs viewport. Sheet: moving a symbol carries its labels and no-connects and reshapes its wires (wires: "leave" keeps them); an `at` that puts a pin off the 1.27 mm grid is refused with the nearest valid one. Reference is not editable here; a value, field or flag is written on every unit of the part. A sheet's size resizes it from its top-left corner, each pin keeping its edge and its place along it. Board: a moved footprint's tracks stay put unless tracks is "follow"; a locked item needs "locked": false to move; the zone fills come back stale until board_refill. A library footprint is writable only in the project's library; a placed one (reference with board) writes the board's copy. Symbols likewise: a library symbol only in the project's library, a placed one (reference, with sheet) its sheet's copy, which every placement drawn from it on that sheet shares. A pin's unit and style are fixed; delete and create to move it.

footprint.description: Act on this footprint: a library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

symbol.description: Act on this symbol definition: a library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

board.description: Act on this board. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path. With footprint, the board a placed footprint is on.

sheet.description: Act on this sheet. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit it — with neither board nor footprint — for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

id.description: An item id from a describe, items_query or items_get.

wires.description: Sheet symbols and sheets: "follow" (default) reshapes the wires on moved pins; "leave" keeps them.

tracks.description: Board footprints: "follow" carries the ends of tracks on its pads with a move, redrawing their last bend; "leave" (default) keeps them. Vias stay put.

record.description: The record as items_get answers it; on update, only the keys that change. Sheets, in sheet millimeters, y down; update (fields is values by name): symbol: at, angle, mirror, dnp, inBom, onBoard, value, fields; field: value, at, angle, hidden; label: text, at, angle; text: text, at, angle; sheet_pin: name, shape, side, at; wire: at; junction: at; no_connect: at; rect: at; sheet: at, size. Create: label: text, labelKind, shape, pin, at, angle; text: text, at, angle, size, bold; no_connect: pin, at; junction: at; rect: box; sheet_pin: ofSheet, name, shape, side, at. Symbols, in millimeters of the symbol frame, y down: pin: number, name, type, shape, at, angle, length, hidden, unit, style, nameSize, numberSize. polyline, bezier: points, width, fill. rect: start, end, width, fill. circle: center, radius, width, fill. arc: start, mid, end, width, fill. text: text, at, angle, size. text_box: text, start, end, angle, size, width, fill. field: key (create only), value, at, angle, size, hidden, justify; graphics also take unit and style on create. Footprints, in millimeters of the footprint's frame, null clearing an override to inherit: footprint (id "footprint", update only): name, description, keywords, locked, attributes {type: smd|through_hole|unspecified, boardOnly, excludeFromPositionFiles, excludeFromBom, allowMissingCourtyard, dnp}, overrides {clearance, solderMaskMargin, solderPasteMargin, solderPasteRatio, zoneConnect: none|thermal|solid|thermal_tht, allowSolderMaskBridges}. pad: number, type, shape, at, angle, size {width, height}, drill {diameter, oval? {width, height}, offset?}, layers, roundrectRatio, chamfer {ratio, corners}, rectDelta {x, y}, thermal {bridgeWidth, gap, zoneConnect}, clearance, solderMaskMargin, solderPasteMargin, pasteRatio. Graphics also take strokeType (default|solid|dash|dot|dash_dot|dash_dot_dot) and strokeColor ("#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA", null the default): line: layer, width, start, end. arc: + mid. circle: layer, width, center, end, fill. rect: + radius. poly: layer, width, points, fill. bezier: layer, width, points (4). Texts also take size (mm, or {width, height}), thickness, bold, italic, justify (left|center|right), verticalJustify (top|center|bottom), mirror, knockout: text: text, at, angle, layer, hidden, keepUpright. property: key (create only), value, at, angle, layer, hidden, keepUpright. text_box: text, start, end, layer, border, width, strokeType, margins {left, top, right, bottom}. point: at, size, layer. table (update only): layer, borderExternal, borderHeader, borderWidth, separatorRows, separatorCols, separatorWidth. zone: points, layers (copper), name, priority, keepout, rules (as a board zone), minThickness, hatchStyle (none|edge|full), hatchPitch; a copper zone also padConnection, padClearance, thermalGap, thermalBridgeWidth, islands; no net. model: path, offset, scale, rotate. Boards: millimeters in board space, y down; nets and layers by name. footprint: at, angle, side ("front"|"back"), locked. track: points (create: a run of {x,y} or pad/via ids, e.g. "U1.3"), layer, width, net; update: start, end, width, layer, net, locked. via: at (a point or a pad id), net, size, drill, layers. zone: points, layers, net, name, priority, minThickness, padConnection ("solid"|"thermal"|"thru_hole_only"|"none", default "thermal"), padClearance, thermalGap, thermalBridgeWidth, islands ("remove"|"keep"); a rule area instead: keepout: true, rules {tracks, vias, pads, copperpour, footprints: "allowed"|"not_allowed"}. line/arc/rect: start, (mid,) end, layer, width, (fill). circle: center, radius. poly: points. text: text, at, angle, layer, size, thickness, hidden. width, size and net default to the net class.

viewport.description: The viewport_open id the user watches this work in; its box moves to frame what the call drew or changed, labeled with action. Required on a sheet or board when the call creates or deletes an item, or its record sets at, angle, mirror, side, size, start, mid, end, center, radius, points, width, layer, layers, drill; a symbol or footprint takes none.

action.description: What this call is doing, at most 32 characters, e.g. "Route USB_DP"; the viewport's box shows it as its label. Required when viewport is.

checks.description: Also run the document's checks and answer with what this write broke or fixed. Off by default; after a burst, call the document's check once instead.

name: items_delete
description: Delete items by id from a sheet, a board, a footprint or a symbol, or from a board by filter. Every id is checked first; one miss refuses the whole call with candidates. One undo step; on a sheet or board it needs viewport. By filter (boards): kind, layer, net and box match as items_query's do, and expect is the count items_query answered for them; any other count refuses the call; a footprint's zones are counted and left. Sheet: a symbol takes the labels and no-connects on its pins with it. Board: locked items are refused; a pad or a footprint's zone goes only with its footprint; a deleted footprint the schematic still has returns on the next board_sync. Footprint: library footprints only in the project's library; a placed one (reference with board) edits the board's copy. Symbol: the same rule with sheet for a placed one; mandatory fields are refused (hide them instead).

footprint.description: Act on this footprint: a library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1") for the board's copy.

symbol.description: Act on this symbol definition: a library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

board.description: Act on this board. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path. With footprint, the board a placed footprint is on.

sheet.description: Act on this sheet. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit it — with neither board nor footprint — for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

ids.description: Item ids, e.g. ["C8"] on a sheet, a uuid on a board, ["model"] on a footprint. Omit to delete by filter.

kind.description: Boards, by filter: items of this kind.

name: items_create
description: Add one item to a sheet, a board, a footprint or a symbol. Answers with the new id; one undo step. On a sheet or board it needs viewport. Sheet: fields go in record; a label, no-connect or directive label goes on a pin (pin) or at a point; a global label joins every sheet's net of that name, a local one only this sheet's; a directive label's netClass sets its net's class. A bus_entry runs from a bus (at) to a wire end (end). Text, graphics, tables and images connect nothing. Board: fields go in record. A track is straight segments through exactly the points given (a pad or via id is a point), with no clearance kept and nothing shoved; to route a connection, use route_begin or route_finish. Its net comes from the pads, and joining two nets is refused. Widths and via sizes default to the net class. Footprint: fields go in record; add a model only when none is linked (else items_update id "model"); a zone is on no net, and keepout: true makes it a rule area. A placed footprint (reference with board) takes items on the board's copy. Symbol: fields go in record; pins and graphics default to unit 1, style 1 (unit 0 is common to all units); a pin needs number and at, a field needs key. A placed symbol (reference, with sheet) takes items on its sheet's copy.

name: items_transform
description: Rotate, mirror, flip, move, duplicate or re-anchor items of a symbol or a footprint, as its editor does. Millimeters in the definition's frame, y down; angle counterclockwise. One undo step on the tab; library definitions only in the project's library, a placed one (reference with sheet or board) its design's copy. Without about, the pivot is the editor's: symbol, the center of the items' extent; footprint, a lone item's own position (a rect or poly, its center), else the center of their box, and flip turns about the origin unless one item flips alone. anchor makes at the origin, shifting every item. Symbol: quarter turns; a field only moves; a duplicate numbers its pins on from the highest number, or with pinStep steps each pin's number and name on from its source. Footprint: flip swaps front and back layers, and a pad with a padstack does not flip; the model and fields do not duplicate.

name: schematic_place_symbol
description: Place a symbol on a schematic sheet at a given point, bound to a real part. One undo step on the sheet's tab. Read the pins of the part it serves with items_get first. Place a passive by its pin: pin plus at puts that pin one grid step out from the served pin, then schematic_wire draws the run. Place a main part by its origin. The reference is assigned from what the design already uses; reference with unit adds that unit to an existing part, which it takes its fields from. A pin that lands on an existing wire or pin joins that net; the answer's `touching` lists them, and a later move drags that wire along. Take mpn and manufacturer from a parts_search result, never from memory; the BOM reads them. A part without a footprint is skipped at board layout.

name: schematic_update_symbols
description: Redraw placed symbols from their library, or change them to another lib id, across the design's sheets. One undo step, unsaved; a sheet without a tab opens behind the active one. Without symbol, each target takes its own lib id's current definition; with symbol, targets change to that lib id. Position, angle, mirror, unit and references stay; pins keep their uuids by number, and a wire on a pin that moves follows it. Targets: references (every unit of each part), else every symbol whose lib id is match, else every symbol. A unit the new symbol lacks stays as it was, on its old symbol, as in KiCad; skipped names it, and the part's other units are written. options defaults follow KiCad: an update takes field text only; a change also takes field look and place, attributes, pin text visibility and alternates. symbols has a row per part: moved, dropped, added and unwired pins (on a wire or label before, on nothing after). Run with dryRun first.

Read before board_update_setup and before routing: the constraints and net class sizes are what DRC measures and what new tracks and vias default to. Each section comes back in the shape board_update_setup takes, in mm. netClasses.matched lists the nets each pattern takes, then Default's (the rest), as Board Setup counts them; it is read-only. severities.rules lists every rule's severity; changed marks the project's overrides, notChecked the rules not run yet.

name: board_sync
description: Put the schematic on the board: add missing footprints, update existing ones, and name parts that cannot land. One undo step on the board tab, unsaved; the tab opens behind when none holds the board. Footprints link to symbols by uuid path, so a re-sync keeps placement and routing and changes only what the schematic changed. A part whose Footprint field is empty or names a footprint no library holds is listed under skipped (a placed one keeps its footprint), and fix says what to write; the rest still lands. New footprints sit unrotated in rows below the outline, grouped by sheet. A footprint whose symbol is gone is an orphan, removed only with prune. A part whose Footprint field names a new footprint is rebuilt from it (footprintReplaced): place, reference and nets stay, and a pad the new one lacks leaves its tracks dangling. Run with dryRun first on a board with work on it.

name: board_fanout
description: Fan out one footprint: give each pad a via and a short track, by dogbone, rows of vias or via-in-pad. One undo step on the board tab, unsaved. Fan out once placement is final, before routing. The board's clearances, hole rules and edge clearance are never loosened. Vias are the net class's unless overridden; stubs take its width, no wider than the pad. escapes lists each new via's id and position: route onward from there. A pad whose via would break a rule is under refused, with the measured gap; the rest still land. For each, choose a surface route, under-pads (via-in-pad, which costs more at the fab: tell the user), or a smaller via override. skipped names pads with nothing to fan out: joined, a pad whose own copper already reaches the rest of its net; via, one whose copper already reaches a via (zones read from their stored fills); surface, the rows surfaceRows kept. New vias report via-dangling until routed, and the zone fills go stale until board_refill. Run with dryRun first.

name: viewport_open
description: Open a labeled box on the user's canvas that shows where you work, or relabel one. Answers a viewport id. Every render and every edit that sets layout takes it and an action, and refuses without them; the box frames what each call drew or changed. label is the box's first label; each later call's action ("Route USB_DP") replaces it with what is happening now. A connection holds one: calling this again relabels and moves it, answering the same id. A document no tab holds opens behind the active one; the user's view never moves. Close it with viewport_close when its block of work is done. It also closes after 10 idle minutes, when its tab closes, when your client disconnects, or when the user closes it; a later call naming it is told which.

name: route_begin
description: Start a routing session: a track begun at a pad, via, track end or point, with the editor's router. Writes nothing of its own; route_step moves, clicks and commits, route_preview compares candidates. The start takes its copper's net and layer, as the route tool's click does. Sizes follow the GUI: net class, then the board's lists by row, then a value. From a pad the head leaves by the pad's exit facing the cursor; to steer it, aim at that way and click a short stub, flip it with posture: "flip", or set settings.smartPads false. The session keeps one route at a time per board. It ends on a new begin, after 10 idle minutes or when its viewport closes, and what it had clicked lands as one undo step, as Esc does; the answer that ends it, else the next begin on the board (ended) or step, says what landed. name: symbol_create
description: Draw a symbol for a part no library has from its pin table, or a blank one, into the project's own symbol library. GoatCAD computes every coordinate; you supply pins and groups. First symbol_search for the part number and family; a generic passive (Device:R with a Value) is refused. Read pins from parts_cache_datasheet then parts_read_datasheet: query 'pin configuration', then that page as an image, since pin numbers are in the package drawing. A family datasheet: take the chosen variant's row. Never invent a pad number; if unreadable, ask. A pad to leave open is omitted; one tied to ground is a ground pin; pads on one net stack with stackWith. Groups are functional: a bus in its conventional order (SDA, SCL), rails power, grounds ground, the rest signal by function. A group stays on one side, so split banks into runs of six to ten. Opens the library as a tab behind. Report pads omitted, stacked or merged. Blank: omit pins and groups for fields only (a power port with power, Reference #PWR), then draw with symbol_batch.

name.description: Symbol name, normally the manufacturer part number, e.g. "SGP41-D-R4".

id.description: Your label, matched by the pins' group field.

role.description: power on top, ground on the bottom, signal on a side. Required: VDD and GND are both power_in.

side.description: Fix the group to one side, overriding role and balancing. Only for a convention, e.g. a regulator's VIN on the left.

groups.description: Functional pin groups; each is kept together on one side.

number.description: Pad number as the datasheet prints it.

name.description: Signal name; stacked pads share the net name (three pads all "GND").

group.description: A group id; required on every pin.

stackWith.description: Pad number on the same net. Stacked at one point; all but the first become passive.

omit.description: Leave off the symbol: a pad the datasheet says to leave open. The footprint keeps it.

pins.description: Every pad on the part, from the datasheet.

power.description: Blank only: make it a power port, its net global or local to its sheet.

reference.description: Reference prefix. Defaults to "U", or "#PWR" for a power port.

value.description: Value field. Defaults to the symbol name.

description.description: One line, as the library shows it.

datasheet.description: Datasheet URL or the cached local path.

library.description: Library file stem. Defaults to the project's own name.

overwrite.description: Replace a symbol of the same name, discarding hand edits to it.

The copy is a new id: place it with schematic_place_symbol. One undo step on the library's tab when one holds it, else the file is written; the library opens as a tab behind.

name.description: Name for the copy. Defaults to the source's name.

library.description: Symbol library (.kicad_sym) stem. Defaults to the project's own name.

name: symbol_delete

name: footprint_compute_land_pattern
description: Compute IPC land pattern pads from a package drawing's dimensions, as a pad table for footprint_create. Only when the datasheet has no recommended land pattern; otherwise transcribe the vendor's. Read every dimension and tolerance off the package drawing, never from memory. body.x and span.x run across the left and right sides, whose pins are pins.y; pins.x counts the top and bottom rows. chip: body.x is the length, lead.length the terminal. grid: ball.diameter, pitch, pins.x columns by pins.y rows, empty positions in skip; land is IPC-7352's ratio of the ball. through_hole: lead.diameter or lead.width and thickness, pitch, pins.y per column, rowSpacing for two columns; only hole and land are computed. The answer is a read: check its pads and notes against the drawing before footprint_create.

leadType.description: gullwing: SOIC, QFP. j_lead: SOJ, PLCC. no_lead: QFN, DFN. flat: molded leads at the body edge. chip: two-terminal R and C. grid: BGA, WLCSP, LGA. through_hole: DIP, SIP, headers.

density.description: IPC density (levels A, B, C = most, nominal, least): most for hand soldering, nominal for reflow, least for dense boards. Defaults to board-intent.md's.

x.description: A drawing dimension: nominal with tolerance, or min and max.

y.description: A drawing dimension: nominal with tolerance, or min and max.

body.description: Package body; x across the left and right sides, a chip's length.

x.description: A drawing dimension: nominal with tolerance, or min and max.

y.description: A drawing dimension: nominal with tolerance, or min and max.

span.description: Lead tip to tip, for leads past the body (gullwing, j_lead).

width.description: A drawing dimension: nominal with tolerance, or min and max.

length.description: Foot length along the axis, or a chip's terminal length. Required for surface mount.

thickness.description: A rectangular through-hole lead's other side; equal to width for a square pin.

lead.description: Lead dimensions. A chip's width defaults to its body's. Not for a grid.

pitch.description: Lead pitch, millimeters. Not for a chip.

x.description: Pins per top and bottom row; a grid's columns.

y.description: Pins per left and right column; a grid's rows; through-hole pins per column.

pins.description: Pins per side: SOIC-8 { y: 4 }, QFN-20 { x: 5, y: 5 }, 10 × 10 BGA { x: 10, y: 10 }.

rowSpacing.description: through_hole: column center to center, millimeters (7.62 for a narrow DIP). Omit for one column.

numbering.description: Two-column through_hole. ccw (default): down the left, up the right (DIP). zigzag: alternating sides (headers).

diameter.description: Ball diameter, or LGA land diameter.

type.description: collapsible (default): solder ball, land smaller than the ball. non_collapsible: column, hard ball or LGA, land larger.

skip.description: grid: empty positions as seen from the top, e.g. "A1" or a block "E5:K11". Rows skip I, O, Q, S, X, Z.

exposedPad.description: Thermal pad size, millimeters; signal pads are kept 0.2 mm clear of it.

name: footprint_create
description: Draw a footprint for a part no library has from its land pattern, into the project's footprint library. You supply pads, body and pin 1; GoatCAD draws silk, pin 1 marker, courtyard, fab outline, texts, corner radii and layers in KiCad's library style, then checks it. It adds no pads. First footprint_search with the package and pitch; draw only when nothing matches or the vendor's pattern differs. Read pads from parts_read_datasheet: query 'recommended land pattern', then that page as an image. Transcribe every pad center and size in millimeters, origin at the part's center; never recall. With no recommended pattern, footprint_compute_land_pattern computes one. Name it as the library names neighbors ('QFN-20-1EP_3x3mm_P0.4mm_EP1.65x1.65mm'). Density and pin 1 marker come from board-intent.md, echoed in the answer. Opens the library as a tab behind.

name.description: Footprint name in its family's library pattern; also the file name.

library.description: Footprint library (.pretty) stem. Defaults to the project's own name.

attributes.description: smd when every soldered pad is surface-mount, else tht.

description.description: One line: family, part, pitch, datasheet URL.

datasheet.description: Datasheet URL or the cached local path.

courtyard.description: Courtyard clearance class: default 0.25 mm, connector 0.5, crystal 0.5, bga 1.0.

number.description: Pad number as printed: "1", "A3", "MP" (mounting), "SH" (shield). Blank only for an unconnected mechanical hole.

type.description: smd surface pad, thru_hole plated hole, np_thru_hole unplated hole.

shape.description: Pad shape. roundrect is the library default for a rectangular SMD pad (radius set for you); an exposed pad is usually rect.

at.description: Pad center; origin at the part's center, y down.

oval.description: Slot size, millimeters, instead of a round hole.

offset.description: Hole offset from the pad center.

layers.description: Defaults: F.Cu F.Paste F.Mask for smd, *.Cu *.Mask for a hole. Pass to drop paste or put a pad on the back.

count.description: Pads in the row, this one included.

numberStep.description: Added to the number per pad. Defaults to 1; -1 counts down.

array.description: A row of identical pads starting at this one. The number must end in digits (7, A1).

pads.description: Every pad on the land pattern, in footprint_get's record shape plus array.

body.description: Package outline from the top view, not the pad extent; exactly one of rect or polygon. Fab, silk and courtyard derive from it.

pin1.description: Pad number the drawing marks as pin 1. Required with more than one pad.

symbol.description: Symbol id "Nickname:Name" whose pin numbers the answer compares with the pads.

Prefer a model a matching standard footprint already links (footprint_get; no download), then the manufacturer's STEP file. You supply the address; it and your stated source are recorded in the folder's index.json. Ask the user before a third-party source. STEP only; the file is parsed before it is kept. Pass url or path, or both to record where a local file came from.

name: parts_cache_datasheet
description: Save a part's datasheet PDF into the project's datasheets/ folder and return its path. The address comes from what a connected distributor published for that exact MPN; there is no url-only fetch. A file another part already saved is reused and named in sharedWith (a series datasheet: find your part inside it). When no link gives a PDF, the refusal lists each link's answer: fetch it yourself and pass path with url, or put data.datasheetUrl in the Datasheet field. Prefer the distributor links over an aggregator's copy. For the user's own PDF pass path alone. Writes the file and datasheets/index.json. Read it with parts_read_datasheet.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number, exactly as parts_search returned it.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer as a distributor reports it, ignoring case; required when several makers list the MPN.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF on disk to adopt instead of fetching.

url.description: With path: the address it came from. A distributor's published link is recorded as that distributor's; any other as user-supplied.

refresh.description: Re-download even if cached. Default false.

name: parts_read_datasheet
description: Read a cached datasheet (by MPN) or a PDF (by path) as an outline, search hits, page text or a page image. Use this rather than your own PDF tools. Pass one of pages, query or image per call; with none, the answer is the page count and outline, which depth narrows to its upper levels. Read outward: outline, then query to find the pages, then pages for their text (layout kept, so table columns stay aligned), then image for a drawing such as pin numbers on a package. Zoom with region rather than a larger scale. Do not read a datasheet whole.

mpn.description: MPN of a datasheet parts_cache_datasheet saved. One of mpn or path.

path.description: PDF path, absolute or project-relative (docs/appnote.pdf). One of mpn or path.

pages.description: Pages as text, 1-based: "5", "5-7", "2,9-10". At most 20, cut at maxChars.

query.description: Phrase to find on every page, case-insensitive; returns matching lines and their pages.

x.description: Left edge, points from the page left.

y.description: Top edge, points from the page top.

region.description: Area to draw, in points from the top-left corner, as a whole-page image reports in frame.

image.description: A page, or a region of one, drawn as a PNG.

depth.description: Outline: keep entries at this depth or above; 0 is the top level. Default every level.

maxChars.description: Character budget for pages text. Default 12000.

name: parts_open_settings
description: Open GoatCAD's Distributor APIs settings so the user can paste an API key. Use after no-credentials or invalid-credentials. Keys cannot be set through this interface.

name: schematic_batch
description: Run several schematic ops on one sheet as one undo step, or dry-run them. Every op is validated before any runs; if one fails, nothing is written and the answer is that op's own failure, its detail naming the index. Read ops are allowed inside; library writes, schematic_annotate and nested batches are refused: call them on their own. Pass checks and viewport on the batch, not on an entry. dryRun answers the change set (and check delta) without writing.

sheet.description: The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Default: the open sheet, else the root sheet.

dryRun.description: Return what the batch would change without writing. Default false.

viewport.description: The viewport_open id for the batch; its box frames what the batch changed, labeled with action. Required when an entry sets layout; entries take none.

action.description: What this call is doing, at most 32 characters, e.g. "Route USB_DP"; the viewport's box shows it as its label. For the whole batch; required when viewport is. Entries take none.

checks.description: Also run the document's checks and answer with what this write broke or fixed. Off by default; after a burst, call the document's check once instead.

name: symbol_batch
description: Run several item operations on one symbol definition as one undo step, or preview them with dryRun. Entries are items_get, items_query, items_update, items_delete and items_create, without symbol, sheet or checks. Reads see earlier entries' edits. If any entry fails, nothing is written and the answer names its index. A sheet's copy is one step on the sheet's tab; a library symbol, on its library's tab. checks: true adds the check delta.

symbol.description: A project library id "Nickname:Name", or a placed reference ("U1") for its sheet's copy.

sheet.description: With a reference: the sheet it is placed on. The sheet's file name with its extension ("power.kicad_sch"), or its absolute path. Omit for the open sheet, else the root sheet.

args.description: The operation's arguments, without symbol or sheet.

dryRun.description: Answer what the batch would change, writing nothing.

checks.description: Also run the document's checks and answer with what this write broke or fixed. Off by default; after a burst, call the document's check once instead.

name: footprint_batch
description: Run several item operations on one footprint as one undo step, or preview them with dryRun. Entries are items_get, items_query, items_update, items_delete and items_create, without footprint, board or checks. Reads see earlier entries' edits. If any entry fails, nothing is written and the answer names its index. A board's copy is one step on the board's tab; a library footprint, on its own tab. checks: true adds the check delta.

footprint.description: A project library id "Nickname:Name", or with board a placed reference ("U1").

board.description: With a reference: the board it is placed on. The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path.

args.description: The operation's arguments, without footprint or board.

dryRun.description: Answer what the batch would change, writing nothing.

checks.description: Also run the document's checks and answer with what this write broke or fixed. Off by default; after a burst, call the document's check once instead.

name: board_batch
description: Run several item operations and placements on one board as one undo step. Entries are items_get, items_query, items_update, items_delete, items_create and board_place_footprint, without board, checks, dryRun or viewport: those go on the batch. Reads see the edits before them; an entry can name an id an earlier one created. If any entry fails, nothing is written. results holds each entry's answer, in order. For entries computed in a loop, use app_scripting: `with gc.transaction(board=True, refill=True):`.

board.description: The board's file name with its extension ("main.kicad_pcb"), or its absolute path; omit for the project's one board.

args.description: Its arguments, without board, checks or dryRun.

refill.description: Refill every zone after the batch, in the same undo step.

dryRun.description: Answer with the changes and write nothing.

viewport.description: The viewport_open id for the batch; its box frames what the batch changed, labeled with action. Required when an entry sets layout; entries take none.

action.description: What this call is doing, at most 32 characters, e.g. "Route USB_DP"; the viewport's box shows it as its label. For the whole batch; required when viewport is. Entries take none.

checks.description: Also run the document's checks and answer with what this write broke or fixed. Off by default; after a burst, call the document's check once instead.
